relay.pairing.title: Approve actions and get alerts on this phone
relay.pairing.title_for_action: Pair this phone to approve from here
relay.pairing.intro.body: Once paired, this phone can approve actions on your computer. You’ll confirm it on your computer, which asks for its own password once.
relay.pairing.unavailable.body: Phone approvals aren’t turned on for your computer yet. On your computer, open Local Operator → Settings → Phone access and turn on phone approvals.
relay.pairing.unavailable.waiting: This screen will continue on its own once they’re on.
relay.pairing.unsupported.body: Local Operator on your computer is too old to pair phones from here. Update it on your computer, then try again.
relay.pairing.filing: Sending the request to your computer…
relay.pairing.waiting.title: Open Local Operator on your computer
relay.pairing.waiting.confirm_body: Check that your computer shows the same code, then approve it there.
relay.pairing.waiting.code_body: Type this code on your computer when it asks.
relay.pairing.waiting.password: Your computer will then ask for its own password.
relay.pairing.waiting.not_seen: Don’t see it? Make sure Local Operator is open on your computer.
relay.pairing.signing: Your computer is confirming — enter your password there.
relay.pairing.failed_retryable: Confirmation was cancelled on your computer — try again there.
relay.pairing.strikes_exhausted: Too many wrong codes — start again.
relay.pairing.denied: The request was declined on your computer.
relay.pairing.expired: The request expired before it was approved.
relay.pairing.withdraw_in_progress: Your computer is already confirming. Finish or cancel it there.
relay.pairing.withdraw_failed: Couldn’t cancel the request. Try again.
relay.pairing.paired.title: This phone is paired
relay.pairing.paired.body: It can now approve actions on your computer.
relay.pairing.paired.not_ready: Your computer can’t check this phone’s approvals yet. On your computer, open Local Operator → Settings → Phone access and turn on phone approvals.
relay.pairing.paired.home_screen: Tip: add this page to your Home Screen so your browser keeps this phone’s pairing.
relay.pairing.return.approve: Paired. Tap Approve again to finish — nothing has been approved yet.
relay.pairing.return.choose: Paired. Choose again to finish — nothing has changed yet.
relay.pairing.return.gone: That request was answered or expired while you were pairing. This phone can approve the next one.
relay.pairing.busy.same_key: This phone already asked to pair.
relay.pairing.busy.other: Another phone is asking to pair with your computer right now. Try again once that request is approved or declined.
relay.pairing.rate_limited: Too many pairing requests. Try again in {countdown}.
relay.pairing.rate_limited_later: Too many pairing requests. Wait a little, then try again.
relay.pairing.revoked: This phone was removed from your computer. Ask again to pair it.
relay.pairing.key_lost: This phone’s pairing was lost when the browser cleared its storage. Pair it again to approve from here.
relay.pairing.refused_signature: Your computer refused this phone’s approval. If the phone was removed there, pair it again.
relay.pairing.error.network: Couldn’t reach your computer. Check the connection and try again.
relay.pairing.error.no_crypto: This browser can’t keep a pairing key safely, so it can’t pair this phone.
relay.pairing.terminal.turn_on_approving: In the terminal app, type {command} so phones can approve requests on this computer.
relay.pairing.terminal.code_intro: Or run {command} on your computer and enter the code it prints here.
relay.pairing.terminal.no_answer: No answer from your computer. Approve this phone there, then try again.
relay.pairing.terminal.invalid_code: That code isn’t valid. Get a fresh one on your computer and try again.
